trackBorderWidth.comment: Disabled track's border — no existing token matches this exact sub-pixel value (closest is borderWidth.sm at 1px)

knobOffset.comment: Knob inset from the track edge when the track has no border (non-disabled)

knobOffsetWithBorder.comment: Knob inset when the track has a border (disabled) — equals trackBorderWidth, so the knob's visible edge lines up the same regardless of state
